title: Too small and not thick enough for me
text: Too small and not thick enough for me. i was disappointed to have to return this  .. just way too small for me and my chair  i liked the material and the feel of the cushion though if it was wider and thicker i would be leaning on it right now  theres really nothing wrong with it  just didnt work for me and my chair
